name: Kage Moonstep
lore: A masked night runner from the rooftops of Moonveil. Kage stitches moonlight into steel and catches every star he sends into the dark.

primary.name: Twin Fang
primary.description: Two quick directional katana cuts, 0.14 seconds apart. Each deals 15 damage within 95 reach; aim both cuts when you start the attack.

secondary.name: Windwheel
secondary.description: Throw a spinning shuriken for 26 outward damage, then 18 return damage. Outward hits cause bleeding for 3 damage per second for 4 seconds; return hits do not apply or refresh bleeding. Each enemy can be hit once per leg. Walls stop it.

special.name: Eightfold Eclipse
special.description: Mark a moon-circle ahead. After a 0.3s warning, eight shuriken spiral inward over 1.2s. Each enemy can take up to three 12-damage star hits; the center then bursts for 18 damage in a 90 radius. Walls block the stars.

passive: Moon Thread: a returning Windwheel marks enemies for 3 seconds. Your next Twin Fang hit consumes the mark for 8 extra damage.

technique.name: Heavy Windwheel
technique.description: Windwheel hits 25% harder outward, but loses 35% of its return damage.

final_technique.name: Moonfall Seals
final_technique.description: Three delayed moon seals deal 24 and briefly stun. Replaces the eightfold teleport sequence; safer placement but no teleport.

attack.name: Moonfall Seals
attack.description: Three delayed moon seals deal 24 and briefly stun. Replaces the eightfold teleport sequence; safer placement but no teleport.
